description: This is a PHP source file defining the ChannelStoryAdminController class within the Goteo application's admin module. The class manages CRUD operations for channel stories, including listing, adding, and deleting stories associated with channels. It also defines routing logic specific to administrative channel story management.

classes.name: ChannelStoryAdminController
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative actions for channel stories, including listing, adding, and deleting stories within channels. It extends AbstractAdminController and defines specific routes and actions for managing stories linked to channels.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name for the controller, which is 'channels'.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines the routing configuration for the controller's actions.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists stories associated with a specific channel identified by ID.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Adds a story to a channel based on request data, with permission checks.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Removes a story from a channel, identified by channel ID and story ID, with permission checks.
